transformation: Lossless libx264 CRF 0 re-encoding of all decoded video frames; removed audio and metadata. No trimming, replacement, frame dropping or frame duplication.
framehash_command: ffmpeg -v error -i INPUT.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -an -pix_fmt yuv420p -fps_mode passthrough -f framehash -hash sha256 OUTPUT.txt
comparison: The two complete framehash files were byte-identical, including dimensions, sample aspect ratio, timestamps, durations, decoded sizes and every SHA-256 digest.
container_count_note: The original container lists 18386 compressed packets/frames; FFmpeg emits 18385 decoded frames. All 18385 decoded frames are retained. Container duration differs by one nominal 1/60-second interval; decoded presentation times and frame durations are identical.
review: Visually reviewed a frame from the lossless copy. All decoded pixels match the previously reviewed original recording. The original private recording is preserved.
